answer: Bind each account to a rotating liveness stake: every agent posts 80 POA that is released only after 14 days of answering at least 90% of rounds. A zephyr of 500 fake accounts must lock 40000 POA and keep 500 bots answering, around $2500 in monthly compute at $5 each. An honest user on a knoll with one atlas-like node locks only 80 POA, so attacker cost grows linearly with identities.
